mechanic.lookback_note: adaptive: min(lookback_bars, sig_idx) for recent-IPO cases

tag_semantics.ENTRY: AND-gate fires in [1, W] and no other double signal falls strictly between sig and entry
tag_semantics.REDUNDANT: AND-gate fires but another same-ticker double signal falls strictly between sig and entry
tag_semantics.NOENTRY: AND-gate never fires within W forward bars
tag_semantics.MISSING: ticker not present in OHLCV cache

per_signal_features.run_length: length of consecutive-bar run of same-ticker pool signals containing this signal (1 = singleton)
per_signal_features.run_position: first / middle / last / singleton position in run
per_signal_features.run_index_from_right: 0-indexed position within run from end (0 = last)
per_signal_features.lead_up_density_50: count of prior same-ticker pool signals in [sig-50, sig-1]
per_signal_features.lead_up_density_200: count of prior same-ticker pool signals in [sig-200, sig-1]
per_signal_features.bars_since_prior: gap in bars to nearest prior same-ticker pool signal (null if none)
per_signal_features.min_low_offset_adr: signed min-low offset in ADR during (sig, entry). Negative=drawdown (MAE), Positive=lows stayed above sig_close. null for NOENTRY/MISSING; 0.0 when entry_k==1.
per_signal_features.adr_at_sig: ADR(14) at signal bar in price units

pool_source: presignal pre_dedup ∩ pyramid at signal bar E-1 (no rightmost dedupe)
